newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end higher at 21.875 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end higher at 21.875 percent.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates edged up on Wednesday as some banks apparently ran out of liquidity after putting their money into the reverse repo facility, dealers said.
"They probably have some funds tied up in the (central bank's) reverse repo facility," said Norbert Kaplar of Corvinbank.
Overnight rates closed at 21.875 percent, up from Tuesday's close of 21.50 percent.
Kaplar added that overnight rates would either remain at current levels or could even rise to between 22 and 22.50 percent, depending on banks' liquidity.
